prompts.input: A group has an identity element e such that ae = ea = a. Explain why this does not imply every element is its own inverse.
A trial found an association between study time and scores but did not randomly assign study time. Explain the limits of its conclusion.
The account describes grief after a death, with uncertainty about what support the family received. Explain what can and cannot be concluded.

rubric: Score 0–2: voice is recognizably consistent with the named character without parody or repeated catchphrases.
Score 0–2: terminology, equations, evidence boundaries and uncertainty remain accurate across all voices.
Score 0–2: explicit output language wins; French Conyo is lively informal French without unsolicited Tagalog.
Score 0–2: questions, wit and historical parallels aid understanding; no invented anecdotes or extra-source facts.
Score 0–2: humour and whimsy are muted for grief; Socratic persona still supplies substantive conclusions.
procedure: Human/live provider evaluation is unrun. With separately authorized credentials, generate each prompt unchanged for all seven personas using the same model/settings, blind-label outputs, then score each rubric dimension. Deterministic tests verify composition only.
